en-US.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
en-US.description: Notes, documents and tasks, all local. No subscription, no telemetry.
en-US.longDescription:
Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
en-US.name: Tisty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Tisty 1.43.0
A new, clearer guide, and you know who signed what is shared with you
- The guide tells you what Tisty is with a diagram you can open and edit, and in each part it invites you to try things right there.
- The guide comes signed by rgdevment, who makes Tisty. "Show it again" in Settings → General brings the new one and keeps the old one in the archive.
- When you bring in a document someone shared with you, Tisty shows "verified" beside what rgdevment signed, and warns you in red when a name only looks like it or a key was taken back.
- The online help and the guide fix details that had fallen behind.
What's Changed
- docs: the assistant door is told as open on a new install, as the app opens it, and one click closes it by @rgdevment in #632
- docs: the README names its alternatives, asks its FAQ as headings and carries the motto by @rgdevment in #633
- docs: the README shows the Product Hunt badge for the launch by @rgdevment in #634
- docs: questions, ideas and how people use Tisty are pointed to Discussions by @rgdevment in #635
- fix(readme): the release badge reads only the app's releases, so the contract pre-releases no longer time it out by @rgdevment in #636
- feat(sharing): the root Folio signs as the maker's shares Tisty's guide under its alias, even while closed by @rgdevment in #637
- feat(guide): the guide is sown as its signer's, checked against the maker's root, and the old one is put away by @rgdevment in #638
- feat(sharing): a received document says who signed it, verifying the maker and flagging imitations by @rgdevment in #639
- docs: the 1.43.0 guide is rewritten to invite you to try each thing, signed by rgdevment, with its news by @rgdevment in #640
- perf(sharing): a Sync sends only what changed, asks Folio nothing when nothing did, and shows its wait by @rgdevment in #641
- feat(sharing): Folio's ten new documents a day are counted, warned of before sharing and refused as tomorrow by @rgdevment in #642
- fix(sharing): main builds its tests again, and Sync lives apart from folio.rs under the size ceiling by @rgdevment in #643
- feat(sharing): Folio's waits are kept on disk, nextAt is heeded before sealing and nothing resends alone by @rgdevment in #644
- docs(sharing): privacy and help say a Sync sends only what changed, and where Folio's waits are kept by @rgdevment in #645
- feat(sharing): the Shared row starts folded and wears a quiet beta mark by @rgdevment in #646
- docs: what a person reads is read against 1.43.0, with the maker's verified mark and the signed guide by @rgdevment in #647
Full Changelog: v1.42.0...v1.43.0

es.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
es.description: Notas, documentos y tareas, todo local. Sin suscripción ni telemetría.
es.longDescription:
Tisty guarda lo que sabes en tu propio equipo: notas, documentos y tareas, en archivos
Markdown que puedes leer sin él. Todo lo que haces se escribe en un registro que solo
crece, así que nada se pierde por accidente y un cambio se puede deshacer; borrar para
siempre es el único paso que no. Sin cuenta, sin
suscripción, sin telemetría y sin servidor. La sincronización, si la quieres, pasa por
una carpeta que tus equipos ya alcanzan, y un asistente entra por una puerta que abres tú.
es.name: Tisty
